changes: SameSuite APU rose from 11/70 to 47/70: +51.43 percentage points and +327.27% more passing cases.
Mealybug DMG pixel-structure similarity rose from 82.7421% to 86.6361%: +3.894 points and +4.71% relative.
A dot-sensitive PPU now handles mid-line register effects, window activation, sprite-fetch stalls, HDMA state, and save-state restoration.
Pulse, wave, noise, envelope, trigger, frame-sequencer, RTC sub-second, EI/HALT, palette-access, and DMA edge cases were corrected.
Minimal audio buffering halves the former lowest queue target to 8 ms; maximum clock correction is 68.75% smaller and console-specific analog curves are used.
Paired throughput improved in five of six audited games by 2.61% to 31.26%; the accuracy-heavy Wario Land 3 path is 9.99% slower but remains over 11× real time.
